newsitem.title: INDONESIA: Coffee - Indonesia prices remain soft, supply tight.
newsitem.headline: Coffee - Indonesia prices remain soft, supply tight.

text.p: Indonesian coffee prices remain soft despite relatively tight supply in the domestic market, traders said on Monday.
They said the continued downtrend was due to depressed prices in offshore markets.
"The harvest is actually over in Indonesia. What we are selling now is only the remainder," one trader in Jakarta said.
He said, however, prices were still soft and an immediate turnaround was not expected in the short term.
He said coffee prices in the main growing areas of Lampung and Palembang were quoted around 2,700 rupiah/kg against 2,750 rupiah/kg last week and 3,400 rupiah in August.
Traders said the export price of grade four Robusta fell to $1,180/tonne from $1,250/tonne last week and against $1,400/tonne last month.
